resources.string: Keep phone folders in sync with Google Drive
Pick any folders on your phone: photos, notes, documents.
Each gets its own folder inside \"Drive Sync\" in your Google Drive.
Nothing is ever deleted for good: removed files go to the trash, and changes on both sides keep both versions.
The app only sees the files it creates in Drive, nothing else.
Setting up the Drive Sync folder…
Get told when a folder needs attention or both sides changed a file.
Android may delay background syncs to save battery. If syncs seem late, let Drive Sync run in the background.
